GNU FreeFont / FreeSans, 20120503; converted SSFN v1 font

The packaged app/ssfndata/FreeSans.sfn derives from GNU FreeFont FreeSans.otf.
Original copyright and contributor details are preserved in AUTHORS, CREDITS,
and README. The font origin is licensed under GNU GPL version 3 or later;
the complete GPLv3 text is supplied in COPYING. There is no warranty.

Modification: conversion from the GNU 20120503 OpenType FreeSans to SSFN v1
outlines at maximum quality, sans-serif family. These converted bytes first
entered OpenCPN on 2024-07-05 (743870c2ab12a852cc9f23b6e60bd2bc7eb433a9).
SKAGER carries those bytes unchanged. The reproduced conversion was verified
on 2026-10-11; its original historical invocation is not known.

README preserves GNU's original document-embedding exception. Its preservation
here records the original terms, without asserting that the optional exception
was extended to the converted font. The SSFN software MIT license is separate
from the font data's GPL terms. Application aggregation/compatibility and final
distribution obligations remain subject to review.

The accompanying SKAGER-Beta2-source.zip contains, under
opennav-x/vendor/freefont-20120503/, the unmodified GNU editable-source archive
(including FontForge SFD, build scripts and notices), original FreeSans.otf,
and unchanged SSFN v1 converter/header with their MIT copyright/license
headers. REBUILD.txt describes their provenance and conversion. These files
are provided alongside the binary; this notice is not a substitute source offer.
